name: Com ga
summary: Cơm gà, as Vietnam Airlines describes it, is turmeric-tinted rice cooked in the water used to boil the chicken, with chicken boiled just done. Some kitchens also serve roti chicken or chicken offal.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the rice fragrant and slightly sticky, and the chicken naturally sweet, with firm meat and a thin skin.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: rice cooked in chicken-boiling water with a little pounded turmeric. Chicken boiled just done. Served with herbs, cucumber, and sweet-sour fish sauce. Some kitchens also serve cơm gà rô ti or cơm lòng gà.
No street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000–70,000 VND a portion.
